answer: To earn at all, an identity must present a signature chain reaching back to a settlement at least 15 epochs old, anchored at a atlas checkpoint. The terrace chain is verified at intake and hollow publishes each anchor. A newly minted alias has no such history, which means it must survive 15 epochs before its first payout, and abandoning it forfeits the wait. Every extra alias adds 11 hours of verification and 3 percent more locked value. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
